body.name: Dataset-specific Fisher sharp-null reference
body.construction: For each \(\rho\in I\) and dataset \(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho}\) realized under \(\mathsf P_n^{h,\rho}\), form \(\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}\), enumerate \(\prod_{s\in S}\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)\), recompute \(X'_{n,s}\) and \(C'_n(\rho)\), retain exactly \(C'_n(\rho)=C_n(\rho)=C\), and then enumerate quota-respecting stage-2 assignments only in retained strata. This gives \(\Omega_{n,C}(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\), cell probability \(p_{\mathrm{ref}}(n,C,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho},\rho)\), normalized kernel \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,C}\), cdf \(F^{\mathrm{ref}}_{n,j}(\cdot;\rho,\theta_j,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho})\), and critical value \(q^{\mathrm{ref}}_{n,j}(\rho,\theta_j,\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho})\).
